verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents enterprise SSO over SAML/OIDC with any compatible IdP, and models organizations alongside enterprise SSO connections (imported from Auth0, managed via dashboard/MCP). A self-serve IT-admin onboarding flow exists, and customers praise its SAML setup wizard. However, the pack never documents verified domains or just-in-time provisioning, and Directory Sync/SCIM is a different provisioning mechanism. missing for 10: verified/claimed domain documentation, JIT user provisioning on first SSO login, explicit per-organization connection configuration docs.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can give each customer organization its own SSO connection with verified domains and just-in-time provisioning

citations.quote: This service is compatible with any IdP that supports either the SAML or OIDC protocols.
import your users, organizations, and enterprise SSO connections from Auth0
managing organizations, connections, users, branding, and more
Enable IT admins to have a self-serve onboarding experience.
We frequently have customers compliment us on how easy it is to configure SAML and SCIM, but it's really WorkOS's wizard that they are complimenting
